heading: 眼睛要搬家
caption:
长大的时候，变化发生了：
一只眼睛慢慢移向另一侧。
我的头部也逐渐改变，
两只眼睛开始住在同一边。
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational children's nature picture book. ONE finished flat page, LANDSCAPE aspect ratio 5:4, 1600×1280 pixels, full bleed, no mockup. Match the user's illustrated cicada reference: HAND-PAINTED naturalistic watercolor and gouache, visible fine pencil contours, luminous translucent washes, gentle dry-brush texture and cream paper grain, delicate realistic animal anatomy, sun-dappled leaves and calm nature. Strongly illustrated painterly medium, not a photograph or 3D render; no humanized eyes, clothes, smiles or cartoon faces. Typography is part of the actual illustration: exact legible simplified Chinese printed in dark ink, large friendly picture-book Song/Kai type, NOT a screenshot or UI. Heading approximately 66px; body approximately 43px with spacious 1.5 line height. Arrange heading and four body lines in naturally pale uncluttered upper-left/upper-right paper or sky/water area, at least 8% safe margin, never on animal bodies or busy textures. Main animal action below or alongside text occupying about 60% of image. Use only supplied text, do not add English, logos, labels, watermarks, arbitrary facts or speech bubbles. Keep all Chinese punctuation and characters exact.
Book: 浪花里的奇妙变身. Environment: shallow coastal sea, sandy bottom, soft seaweed, sunbeams and quiet turquoise waves. Ink color: deep ocean blue.
Scene and scientific constraints: Two developmental stages of same right-eyed flounder in a single soft continuous underwater scene: larger juvenile with one eye migrating across top of head toward right side, smaller earlier symmetrical fish in distance, gentle natural side/three-quarter view. No detached floating eyeballs, no arrows or diagrams. Pale upper left space.
Text (verbatim), short heading: 「眼睛要搬家」. Body in these exact separate lines:
